# Retail shelf detector

*Client industry: retail | Completed: 2021-06-27 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p06*

## The problem
The client was a merchandising firm auditing shelves from phone photos.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python, a deep learning framework with custom training loops, classical image processing before the neural network. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project detected out-of-stock gaps with 0.88 mAP.
